asset: Compact SMG SM-01 (SMG01): reference measurement of the user's Sheet A
source: References/Guns/SMG/smg_sheetA.webp (1254x1254, AI-generated; panels LEFT, RIGHT, TOP, 3/4 FRONT VIEW (LEFT))
tool: WorkFiles/guns/smg/tools/trace_reference.py (regenerates this file, trace/ and the overlay)

frame.axes: +X toward the muzzle, +Z up, +Y = gun left (right-handed)
frame.origin: X = 0 at the rearmost point of the butt pad, stock extended; Z = 0 on the bore axis (direction = top rail tooth-top line; height = muzzle device / barrel centre line); Y = 0 on the mid-plane
frame.units: mm unless the key ends in _px

sides.evidence: LEFT panel: charging handle knob at the front upper receiver (real pattern: left side); no ejection port. RIGHT panel: the ejection port (rectangular window at the receiver top-middle) and no knob (real pattern: port on the right). TOP (muzzle image-left, so gun left = image-down for a camera above): the knob protrudes image-down = left. 3/4 FRONT VIEW (LEFT) shows the knob. Selector levers on both sides (ambidextrous, as the prompt asks) at the same X within 4.9 mm. No panel is mirrored.

folded_length_muzzle_tip_to_hinge_gap.note: the folded gun's length is set by the receiver + hinge (the folded stock lies alongside); the hinge gap is the rear end

barrel_200_check.note: a 200 mm barrel ending at the device seat would put the breech at X 383, over the magazine's rear half and behind the ejection port's rear edge; the sheet's feed geometry (magazine front wall extended up to the receiver seam: X 447; magwell front face X 488; port X 407-464) puts the breech face at about X 451-461 (just ahead of the magazine's top front, at the port's front edge), i.e. a hidden barrel of about 132-147 mm to a crown inside the device collar (X ~593-598)

scale.global_scale_note: 625 mm is the orchestrator ruling of 2026-10-09 (spec resolution R26). At the real pattern's 690 the sheet's grip / trigger group was 13-29 % larger than real (trigger reach 90.5 vs ~70); at ~625 the side-view rail pitch is exactly 10.01 and the receiver width matches the real 61, so the sheet was evidently drawn at ~625. Every silhouette proportion stays the sheet's (one uniform scale); the anchors below show what remains off the real pattern
scale.uncertainty_note: unc_mm = 1-sigma measurement uncertainty from the edge types (silhouette +-0.4 px, hand-placed seam +-1 px, estimate +-2 px) at that view's scale; it does not include the scale choice

scale_ruling.note: orchestrator ruling 2026-10-09 (spec R26): 625 mm overall, all silhouette proportions the sheet's; at ~625 the side-view rail pitch is exactly 10.01 and the receiver width matches the real 61 mm; overall 690 -> 625 (-9.4 %), folded and height follow the sheet's proportions

left_vs_right.method: RIGHT panel mirrored; both side views in the gun frame independently (own rail-direction axis, own bore height, X = 0 at the rearmost butt pad point, own scale to 625 mm) and compared without fitting; a free similarity fit (max IoU) is the secondary number

profile_diff_RIGHT_minus_LEFT_mm.note: outermost top / bottom silhouette Z at stations every 10 mm (RIGHT minus LEFT)

length_stock_extended.how: butt pad rearmost point to muzzle device tip along the bore (set = 625)

height_with_magazine.how: sight top to magazine floor plate bottom

length.how: tip to the rear of its collar (seam x 53.5)

diameter.how: median outer diameter over the slotted body

muzzle_device.note: slotted cylindrical flash hider (birdcage-like, 3+ long slots visible) with a rear collar

exposed_length.how: device collar to receiver front face

neck_diameter.how: exposed barrel neck just behind the device

front_collar_diameter.how: the ring / barrel nut against the receiver front face

device_seat_X.how: rear of the device collar = MuzzleSeat

pitch_autocorr.how: autocorrelation of the tooth-top profile between the sights (peak 0.68)

sights.note: flip-up sights drawn UP: front = post between protective ears; rear = diopter (aperture) between ears; both clamp on the top rail. The aperture and post tips are not resolved in the side view

length_front_face_to_rear_end.how: front face (barrel collar seam) to the rear end at the hinge block seam

upper_lower_seam_Z.how: horizontal seam y 211 from the hinge to x 219

receiver.note: the upper is one housing incl. the slotted front (handguard area) and the rail; the lower is the grip frame with magwell and trigger guard; seams as drawn (hand-read)

magazine.rake_note: angle of the magazine's centre line from the perpendicular to the bore; + = the edges move toward the muzzle going UP (top forward of the bottom), - = the floor plate is forward of the top. Edge fit rms 0.20 / 0.15 mm

thickness_estimate_from_3q.how: 3/4 view: view yaw theta = asin(width / height of the muzzle device's end-face ellipse) = 36.9 deg; thickness = LEFT front-to-back width 42.2 x (front-face px / side-face px = 0.494) / tan(theta); +-5 deg on theta gives the uncertainty

mag_well.note: the lip is the flared lower edge of the well; it slopes up toward the muzzle (front higher)

outer_width_estimate_from_3q.how: magwell-lip front face 31.0 px / (local px/mm 1.170 x sin theta)

axis_rake_deg_from_perpendicular_to_bore.how: mean of the front edge fit (Z -138..-58, rms 0.94 mm) and the backstrap fit (upper part, rms 0.44 mm); + = the bottom is behind the top

grip.taper_note: the grip widens toward the bottom (backstrap rakes more than the front strap: palm swell / flared heel)

trigger_reach_to_blade_front_face.how: parallel to the bore at Z -70.5 (blade lower third): backstrap line (grip rear edge, upper part) to the blade's front (finger) face

dimensions_LEFT.trigger_reach_note: the finger pad rests on the blade's front face; real-pattern reach for a full-size rifle-type grip is about 65-75 mm (at 690 mm the sheet's trigger group was drawn 13-29 % large; at 625 it reads as measured here; see the scale cross-checks)

hinge_axis_estimate.note: the hinge axis is vertical (side-folding stock) and sits at the gap between the receiver's hinge block and the stock knuckle; its lateral (Y) position is not shown (real pattern: the stock folds to the gun's right, axis at the right rear corner)

charging_handle.side: LEFT (front upper receiver, below the rail)

reference_points.Grip_note: GUN_BUILDING_STUDY 5.1: on the grip axis, 40 mm down from the grip/receiver junction (web line, here the grip front's top at the trigger guard, Z of panel y 241); provisional until H1

receiver_body_width_plain.how: median over the plain middle of the receiver (X 356-464, no lateral features)

front_body_width.how: slotted front section between the charging handle knob and the front sight base (X 507-529)

front_sight_zone_width.how: front sight base / ears zone; protrudes to the gun's right in TOP

body_rear_end_X_width_drop.how: first width drop below 85 % of the plain body width, going rearward

overall_width_max.how: incl. the charging handle knob and the butt pad

q34_reads.note: both front faces have the same orientation and nearly the same depth, so their width ratio does not depend on the view angle or scale
